name: lawdb-ai
description: LawDB.ai - US lawyer directory (static site + Cloudflare Worker API + D1 database)

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js src/lib/*.js src/routes/*.js src/render/*.js scripts/*.mjs admin/*.js account/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && node scripts/build-case-pages.mjs --check && node scripts/test-ai-match.mjs && node --no-warnings scripts/test-network.mjs && node --no-warnings scripts/test-home-showcase.mjs && node --no-warnings scripts/test-signup.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.deploy:ci: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
